::: {.section-intro}
How are AI and energy shaping each other—and what might that mean for ordinary people?
:::

This is an ongoing independent learning and research initiative, exploring AI infrastructure, electricity systems, regulatory developments, and their implications for business and society.

The work will develop through accessible explanations and a curated watch on developments across the US, EU, and China. Articles and updates are still in preparation.

::: {.category-links}
[AI–Energy Explained](#explained){.text-link}

[AI–Energy Watch](#watch){.text-link}
:::

## AI–Energy Explained {#explained}

Accessible educational and analytical articles for readers without a technical background. Questions to explore include:

- How can we understand the connections between AI infrastructure and electricity systems?
- What should we look for when reading an AI and energy headline?
- How can we compare claims and check their sources?
- What might these changes mean for our work, communities, and everyday choices?

::: {.editorial-note}
**Articles in preparation.** Each article will link to original sources and make its scope, evidence, and uncertainties clear.
:::

## AI–Energy Watch {#watch}

Curated, dated developments across three regions, with links to original sources and an explanation of why each item matters.

### United States

Planned coverage: AI development, electricity infrastructure, and the decisions shaping their growth.

### European Union

Planned coverage: AI policy, energy transitions, and their implications for daily life.

### China

Planned coverage: AI development, energy infrastructure, and the choices connecting them.

::: {.editorial-note}
**Watch updates to come.** Future entries will include a region, the event date, the publication or update date, original source links, and a distinction between reported facts and my interpretation.
:::
